crossRefs.note: In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan…
Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in…
I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will make the fish of your rivers stick to your scales. I will bring you up out of…
I’ll cast you out into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your rivers. You’ll fall on the open field. You won’t be…

translations.web: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
translations.bsb: Can you put a cord through his nose or pierce his jaw with a hook?
translations.kjv: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
translations.asv: Canst thou put a rope into his nose? Or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
